Connect a phone

Connect to the same staff Wi-Fi as the server. In the phone browser, open the server’s network address followed by /mobile, then sign in with an employee account.

When viewing this page through the network address, this link works on other phones:

If this link says localhost or 127.0.0.1, use the network address shown in the server window instead. Save the page as a bookmark or use your browser’s Add to Home Screen option. The server must stay running; changes require a connection.

OneDrive backups & recovery

Save complete backups of appointments, vehicles, employee accounts and settings. Choose a OneDrive folder on the server computer.

Recent, future, unfinished, and recently edited entries stay on the server. Older entries, photos and history are verified in Dispatch Journal before removal from the active database.

Historical reports read Dispatch Journal. Keep OneDrive running and allow archived files to download when needed. Use OneDrive Files On-Demand to free local space after syncing. Journal files are retained indefinitely; do not delete them.

Keeps the latest 90 complete backups. “Saved” means written to the local OneDrive folder; confirm OneDrive shows it synced. Backups contain customer information and accounts.

To recover on a replacement computer: install the Server, choose Exit server from its truck tray menu, then open Restore MGC YFC Operations Server from the Start menu and select a synced backup ZIP. Sign in using an account from that backup, then reconnect the OneDrive folder.

Update MGC YFC Operations Server

After installing a server update, notify connected users to reload their web app. Offline users see the notice when they reconnect.
